_comment: Canonical MOTION semantics. This is the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for 'how state changes over time'. Motion answers exactly one question -- how does state change over time -- and must NOT re-implement the other subsystems' truth: time/easing belongs to timeline (easing_vocabulary.v1), space/transform/box belongs to geometry (transform_vocabulary.v1), visual object identity belongs to primitives (primitive_catalog.v1). This contract replaces the three previously-forked motion vocabularies (runtime/motion, runtime/motion_runtime, runtime/scene) with one canonical set; legacy spellings are preserved ONLY as aliases so behaviour-preserving migration can map old call sites. See runtime/docs/motion-inventory.md for the audit that produced this normalization.

motion_owns: how a chosen action maps to channel deltas over progress
state change / cross-beat continuity / entrance lifecycle
motion_must_never: declare what visual primitives exist (use primitives.catalog)

observer_independence._comment: runtime/observer/* and its projection contracts are a VALIDATOR, not a producer. They stay independent and are deliberately NOT merged into motion_canonical: a validator that reuses the producer's internals proves nothing.
observer_independence.rule: observer must not import motion_canonical internals, and motion_canonical must not import observer

categories._comment: How an action participates in attention: entering, leaving, being emphasized, expressing relationship, changing its own state, continuing from the previous beat, or explicitly not moving.
categories.relational: a relationship between elements is shown
categories.state: the element changes its own state
categories.continue: carry the previous beat's state (no re-entrance)

produces._comment: Channel delta vocabulary an action may touch. Spatial channels (dx/dy/scale/rotation) are turned into a transform by geometry; opacity/connect/emphasis are non-spatial state.

defaults.easing_resolution: every action easing name MUST resolve through timeline.easing; unresolved names are a divergence
defaults.motion_span_model: absolute times are produced by adding duration + delay (same span model as timeline)

vocabulary._comment: Canonical actions are declared in runtime/motion_canonical/vocabulary.py; this contract names the categories and the merge provenance, not a frozen list (the list is introspected by the audit).

production_consumers._comment: The real pipeline (runtime/pipeline.py) runs on entrance_planner, whose motion vocabulary must map onto canonical actions.

sequencing._comment: motion_canonical.sequencing owns WHO goes WHEN and HOW they group; it does not own curve math or absolute time. Grammar -> mode is a semantic intention, not a template.

known_divergences._comment: Tracked, not silently 'fixed'. Quantified by runtime/motion_canonical/*.audit().

legacy_packages.runtime/motion: not imported by the production pipeline; NOT in production path (migrate/delete in PHASE 6)
legacy_packages.runtime/motion_runtime: not imported by the production pipeline; easing/matrix already delegated (migrate/delete in PHASE 6)
legacy_packages.runtime/scene: not imported by the production pipeline; keeps its visual-compilation role, motion parts converge here

known_divergences.observer_smoothstep: observer's own smoothstep remains intentional and independent
